name: DataGrid
intent: An editable table: people click a cell to add or change its content, like rule conditions, line items or mappings.
usage: Use DataGrid when people enter or change data in rows, not just read it. It is one component: pass columns and rows as data. Each column has a type: text and number cells edit in place with a kit Input, select cells are a kit Select, formula cells open a kit FormulaEditor in the cell, date cells are a kit DatePicker, and readOnly columns only show. Click a cell or press Enter to edit; Enter or leaving the cell saves, Escape cancels, Tab moves to the next cell. rowNumbers adds a # column. canAddRows adds an Add row button under the grid and canRemoveRows a remove button on each row. Columns are at least 160 wide unless they hug. The first column (and #) stays pinned when the grid scrolls sideways. setForAll on a column adds a Set for all menu under its title. detail makes rows expandable, with settings or sub-rows under each row. For read-only lists use Table. See contracts/datagrid.json for the full contract.

columns.itemShape: { key: string; header: string; type?: "text" | "number" | "select" | "formula" | "date"; options?: SelectOption[]; searchable?: boolean; searchPlaceholder?: string; placeholder?: string; readOnly?: boolean; hug?: boolean; width?: string; fields?: FormulaField[]; onCalculate?: (formula: string) => string; setForAll?: boolean }
columns.note: type defaults to text. options for select. date cells are always a kit DatePicker (size sm); their value is an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD, shown formatted, and placeholder fills the empty field. fields and onCalculate for formula, passed to the FormulaEditor. hug makes the column only as wide as its content; otherwise it is at least 160 wide. width is a CSS width. searchable adds a search field at the top of a select column's list that filters options by label, for long lists like a product catalog; searchPlaceholder names it (default Search). setForAll adds a Set for all menu under the column title: Use row 1 value copies the first row's value to every row, Clear all rows empties the column.

rows.note: Controlled rows, one value per column key.

defaultRows.note: Starting rows when rows is not controlled.

onRowsChange.note: (rows: DataGridRow[]) => void. Runs when a cell is saved and when rows are added or removed.

size.note: Row height 48 / 56, header 40 / 48, same as Table. Without a size, a surrounding Density in compact makes it sm. Formula cells grow while they are edited.

line.note: The line under the header row: medium is 2px, thin is 1px. Every header takes it, with or without Set for all.

rowNumbers.note: A # column with each row's number.

canAddRows.note: An Add row button under the grid. The new row starts empty and its first cell opens for editing.

canRemoveRows.note: A remove button at the end of each row, named by a kit Tooltip.

emptyLabel.note: Shown across the columns when there are no rows.

label.note: Names the grid for screen readers, and each cell's field, like Value, row 2.

stickyFirstColumn.note: The # column and the first column stay in place while the grid scrolls sideways; their end border is the same thin line as every cell. Put the column that names each row first.

detail.note: (row: DataGridRow) => ReactNode. Makes rows expandable: a toggle column comes first, and an open row shows this under it in one cell across the grid, kept to the grid's visible width. Put kit pieces in it: a Form of settings, or a nested DataGrid (size sm) for sub-rows like rate bands.

expanded.note: Controlled: ids of the rows whose detail is open.

defaultExpanded.note: Starting open rows when expanded is not controlled.

onExpandedChange.note: (ids: string[]) => void. Runs when a row opens or closes.

useWhen: People build or change rows of data in place: rule conditions, price tiers, field mappings, line items.
Short editable lists where a form per row would be slow.
doNot: Do not use it to show data people only read. Use Table.
Do not invent an EditableCell, GridRow or a table of loose inputs. Pass columns with a type.
Do not build your own expand arrows or a second table under a row. Pass detail.
Do not put a Form around each row. Save the rows from onRowsChange.
a11y: A native table named by label, with kit HeaderCell headers.

Each editable cell is a button named by its column and row with its value, like Value, row 2: 100. Enter or click opens a kit Input, Select or FormulaEditor named the same way, and focus moves into it.
Enter saves and Escape cancels; focus goes back to the cell. Tab moves to the next cell.
Remove row buttons are named Remove row 2 and show that in a Tooltip.
Set for all is a kit DropdownMenu under the column title; the header is still the kit HeaderCell.
With detail, each row starts with a kit Button named Show details, row 2 (Hide when open), with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the open detail, a group named Details, row 2.
A date cell is a kit DatePicker named by its column and row, like Start date, row 2.
snippet:
<DataGrid
  label="Conditions"
  columns={[
    { key: "field", header: "Field", type: "formula", fields: accountFields },
    { key: "condition", header: "Condition", type: "select", options: conditions, width: "200px" },
    { key: "value", header: "Value" },
  ]}
  rows={rules}
  onRowsChange={setRules}
  canAddRows
  canRemoveRows
/>

examples.title: Conditions
examples.usage: Field is a formula cell, Condition a Select and Value text. Click a cell to edit it; add and remove rows.

examples.title: Line items
examples.usage: number cells align to the end. A readOnly column shows values people cannot change. Small size for denser rows. Quantity has Set for all under its title.

examples.title: Dates and details
examples.usage: Start and End are date cells. Each row opens to its rate bands, a nested grid with a Currency select; the first row starts open.

examples.title: Empty
examples.usage: No rows yet: headers stay, and Add row starts the first one.
